title: Bitwise XOR (The Cipher Twin)
style: glitch hop, heavy 808 sub bass, chopped synth stabs, vocoded male lead, female harmony, hard-hitting drums, 110 BPM, zynthio math foundations, cyberpunk-precise
lyrics:
[Intro — 808 kick, glitch synths]
(spoken) Bitwise XOR. The cipher twin.

[Verse 1]
Zero zero, output zero
One one, output zero too
Zero one or one zero, output one
The truth table simple and clean as it's done

[Pre-Chorus]
XOR is its own inverse, the magic gate
Apply twice and you get the original state

[Chorus]
BITWISE XOR — THE CIPHER TWIN
BITWISE XOR — THE STREAM OF SIN
BITWISE XOR — ONE-TIME PAD UNBROKEN
BITWISE XOR — EVERY BIT SPOKEN

[Verse 2]
A xor B xor B equals A
The key returns, the ciphertext goes away
Swap two ints with no temp variable
The bit-twiddler's trick, irrevocable

[Bridge — spoken]
The carrot symbol in the code.
The addition without the carry mode.
Galois fields and Reed-Solomon care.
XOR holds the line in the air.

[Final Chorus]
BITWISE XOR — THE BIT-LEVEL DANCE
BITWISE XOR — THE SECOND CHANCE
BITWISE XOR — ZYNTHIO MATH ENGAGES
BITWISE XOR — THE CIPHER PAGES
